hero.description: Simplify Enterprise connection, student profile management, interview scheduling, and capability evaluation with a smart, transparent digital system.

f1.title: Flexible OJT Semester Management
f1.desc: Automatically create internship semesters, set evaluation criteria, expected outcomes, and manage student progress systematically.

f2.title: Enterprise Collaboration 3.0
f2.desc: Employers directly approve CVs, post job openings, and provide feedback on training quality all through a single portal.

f3.title: Rubric-based Reports & Evaluation
f3.desc: Students submit weekly reports and are evaluated by Enterprise Mentors and Lecturers using standardized, transparent Rubric scales.

f4.title: Role-based Access Control (RBAC)
f4.desc: Maximum information security with detailed access control for 6 roles: Admin, Training Manager, Enterprise, Mentor, Lecturer, Student.

f5.title: Automated Interview Scheduling
f5.desc: The system automatically detects scheduling conflicts, arranges direct interview rooms between Enterprises and Students, and sends instant email reminders.

f6.title: Realtime Statistics Dashboard
f6.desc: Visualize OJT data with real-time charts on student status, soft skills assessment, and internship placement distribution.

s1.title: OJT Preparation
s1.desc: The school opens a new OJT semester, imports eligible student information, and sets up standardized criteria.

s2.title: Recruitment & Interviews
s2.desc: Enterprises post job listings. Students submit CVs online and schedule interviews through the system.

s3.title: Internship & Reporting
s3.desc: Students work at the enterprise, submit weekly reports. Enterprise Mentors track, guide, and sign off.

s4.title: Evaluation & Summary
s4.desc: Enterprises provide grading evaluations. Lecturers grade final reports. The system aggregates scores and exports Excel files.

featuresSection.subtitle: Core Features
featuresSection.title: Professional Internship Management
featuresSection.description: Designed tailored solutions for all stakeholders participating in the OJT enterprise semester.

ctaSection.description: Sustainable partnership, seamless tracking, efficient management. Experience the best internship management system.

processSection.subtitle: Operational Process
processSection.title: Four Smart Closed-Loop Steps
processSection.description: Synchronous and smooth operation among School - Student - Enterprise.

aboutSection.subtitle: About Us
aboutSection.title: Modern Bridge between University & Enterprise
aboutSection.p1: The University Enterprise Internship Management System (UEIMS) is an optimized digital platform built to serve the On-the-Job Training (OJT) semester at FPT University Da Nang.
aboutSection.p2: We completely eliminate manual administrative barriers, directly connecting the university, students, and employers to co-create the highest quality practical learning experiences.

i1.title: 100% Digitized
i1.desc: All report forms, CV approvals, and Rubric grading are done entirely online.

i2.title: Multi-party Sync
i2.desc: Real-time information updates between Students, Instructors, and Partner Enterprises.

i3.title: Direct Recruitment
i3.desc: Enterprises post OJT job openings, actively filter CVs, and quickly schedule interviews.

i4.title: Transparent Statistics
i4.desc: Visually track progress and export complete, accurate OJT report data with just one click.

partnerSection.title: Partner with high-quality human resources
partnerSection.description: Register for partnership now to access thousands of dynamic technology, business, and design students from FPT University, while rapidly digitizing your intern onboarding operations.
